title: Nvidia CEO on AI Market Turmoil: ‘All of This Is Going to Pass’
hook_text: One trillion dollars vanished in tech
script:
One trillion dollars vanished as global tech stocks faced intense market pressure.
Investors questioned massive infrastructure spending on new chips and data centers.
Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang spoke out against the growing panic.
Huang stated that all of this market turmoil is simply going to pass.
He remains confident that chip demand will stay exceptionally high across data centers.
Will your portfolio recover from this drop?
